subject: Day 1: The angel and the girl
title: The angel and the girl
body:
Good morning.

An old priest struck silent and a teenage girl who says yes: I am the Lord's servant. One chapter a day, and you will finish the whole story of Jesus by Christmas Eve.

subject: Day 2: The manger, early
title: The manger, early
body:
Good morning.

You get the Christmas story on December 2, and you will get to read it again with new eyes on Christmas Eve when you finish the book. The shepherds went and told everyone. That is still the assignment.

subject: Day 3: The voice
title: The voice
body:
Good morning.

John the Baptist prepares the way, and at Jesus' baptism the Father speaks: You are my Son, whom I love. Everything starts from being loved.

subject: Day 4: Tempted and anointed
title: Tempted and anointed
body:
Good morning.

Jesus faces the tempter with nothing but Scripture, then announces His mission in His hometown: good news to the poor, freedom for the prisoners. They loved it until they realized He meant it.

subject: Day 5: Deep water
title: Deep water
body:
Good morning.

Put out into deep water. Peter had fished all night and caught nothing, but at His word he let down the nets. Do not be afraid; from now on you will fish for people.

subject: Day 6: Level ground
title: Level ground
body:
Good morning.

Luke's sermon on the plain: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you. Blessed are you who are poor. It is the upside down kingdom, stated flat out.

subject: Day 7: Your faith has saved you
title: Your faith has saved you
body:
Good morning.

A centurion's servant, a widow's son, and a sinful woman weeping at His feet while the religious men squirm. Jesus sees her, and says so. He sees you too.

subject: Day 8: Storms and legions
title: Storms and legions
body:
Good morning.

He calms a storm, frees a tormented man, heals a bleeding woman, and raises a little girl. Who is this? Even the wind and the water obey him. Keep asking.

subject: Day 9: Who do you say I am
title: Who do you say I am
body:
Good morning.

Peter answers the question of the whole book: God's Messiah. The transfiguration follows. Listen to him, the Father says. That is still the best advice ever given.

subject: Day 10: The Samaritan
title: The Samaritan
body:
Good morning.

Go and do likewise. And then Mary at His feet: only one thing is needed. Busy season, this chapter. Read it twice.

subject: Day 11: Teach us to pray
title: Teach us to pray
body:
Good morning.

The Lord's Prayer, and a Father who gives good gifts. Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find.

subject: Day 12: Do not worry
title: Do not worry
body:
Good morning.

Consider the ravens. Consider the lilies. Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father has been pleased to give you the kingdom. December needs this chapter.

subject: Day 13: The narrow door
title: The narrow door
body:
Good morning.

A crippled woman stands straight after eighteen years, and Jesus grieves over Jerusalem like a hen gathering chicks. He has wanted to gather you for a long time.

subject: Day 14: The great banquet
title: The great banquet
body:
Good morning.

Invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, the blind, and you will be blessed. The kingdom is a feast, and the guest list is longer than anyone expected.

subject: Day 15: Lost and found
title: Lost and found
body:
Good morning.

The sheep, the coin, the son. The father runs. If you only had one chapter of Luke, it would be this one.

subject: Day 16: Two masters
title: Two masters
body:
Good morning.

You cannot serve both God and money. Luke never lets us look away from what we do with what we have. Neither should we.

subject: Day 17: One came back
title: One came back
body:
Good morning.

Ten healed, one thankful. Where are the other nine? After a month of gratitude in November, this chapter reads differently.

subject: Day 18: Like a child
title: Like a child
body:
Good morning.

Anyone who will not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it. The blind beggar shouts louder when the crowd tells him to hush. Good strategy.

subject: Day 19: Zacchaeus
title: Zacchaeus
body:
Good morning.

The Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost. Then the King rides into Jerusalem on a donkey while the stones almost cry out.

subject: Day 20: Whose image
title: Whose image
body:
Good morning.

Give back to Caesar what is Caesar's, and to God what is God's. The coin bears Caesar's image. You bear God's. That settles whose you are.

subject: Day 21: Watch and pray
title: Watch and pray
body:
Good morning.

Jesus talks about hard days ahead and says: stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near. Hope has a posture.

subject: Day 22: The last supper
title: The last supper
body:
Good morning.

This is my body given for you. Then Gethsemane, the betrayal, and Peter's bitter weeping. He knows what it costs, and He goes anyway.

subject: Day 23: Father, forgive them
title: Father, forgive them
body:
Good morning.

The crucifixion, and Luke alone records the thief: Jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom. Today you will be with me in paradise. Grace to the last hour.

subject: Day 24: Christmas Eve: hearts burning
title: Christmas Eve: hearts burning
body:
Good morning.

You finish Luke tonight, on the road to Emmaus, hearts burning as He opens the Scriptures. And tomorrow morning, the manger will not read like a children's story anymore. You know exactly who was born. Merry Christmas.

subject: Day 25: Christmas: the Word became flesh
title: Christmas: the Word became flesh
body:
Good morning.

Merry Christmas. Today, John 1: the Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. This is what the manger meant. One verse of it is worth the whole morning.

subject: Day 26: He washed their feet
title: He washed their feet
body:
Good morning.

This week we sit in John's upper room. Jesus, knowing He came from God and was returning to God, picked up a towel. Love looks like that.

subject: Day 27: Let not your hearts
title: Let not your hearts
body:
Good morning.

I go to prepare a place for you. I am the way and the truth and the life. Peace I leave with you. Read it slowly; it was said to frightened friends the night before the cross.

subject: Day 28: The vine
title: The vine
body:
Good morning.

Remain in me. Apart from me you can do nothing. As the year ends, this is the one word worth carrying into the next: remain.

subject: Day 29: He prayed for you
title: He prayed for you
body:
Good morning.

Jesus prays for those who will believe through the disciples' message. That is you, by name, prayed for by Jesus the night before He died.

subject: Day 30: Finished and risen
title: Finished and risen
body:
Good morning.

The cross and the empty tomb, John's telling. It is finished, and then Mary hears her name. Both of those words are for you.

subject: Day 31: Follow me
title: Follow me
body:
Good morning.

The year ends on a beach at breakfast, with Jesus restoring Peter and saying the words He started with: follow me. That is the whole invitation for the new year. Happy New Year, friend.
